title: Insert and remove in the middle of small vectors
summary: Fill short inline-capacity vectors by inserting at generated positions, remove elements from generated positions, and read the remaining elements in order.
notes: Cargo only: no npm or JSR package in this category. Each call builds 64 to 512 vectors with inline capacity 8 using insert at a position, then remove and pop, which shift elements. Rust allocation-counting overhead is included in CPU figures.
